tagline: GAF Master Elite Roofing & Insurance Claim Specialists

why_choose_us.title: GAF Master Elite® President's Club
why_choose_us.description: Fewer than 2% of roofing contractors in the country hold this certification. It is what unlocks GAF's strongest material and workmanship warranties — coverage backed by the manufacturer, not only by us.

why_choose_us.title: We stand with you at the adjuster meeting
why_choose_us.description: Our inspector is on the roof when your insurance adjuster is. We document what we find, put it in writing, and supplement anything the estimate misses. 181 of our Google reviews mention insurance claim help by name.

why_choose_us.title: Nine offices, none of them a truck from out of state
why_choose_us.description: Carrollton, Houston, San Antonio, Austin, College Station, Atlanta, Wilmington, Raleigh and North Myrtle Beach. After the storm passes, we are still at the same address.

why_choose_us.title: 4.9 stars across 1,802 reviews
why_choose_us.description: 1,769 of them are five stars. Read enough and the same crew names keep coming up — Cody, Linc, Ryan, Brinson. That is what a team that stays looks like.
